role: Executive Director, Northwestern Indiana Regional Planning Commission
stance_basis: letter confirms procedural requirement for Interstate Planning Committee review without expressing support or opposition to the project
summary: Norman E. Tufford, as Executive Director of the Northwestern Indiana Regional Planning Commission, wrote to NIPC confirming that the Lincoln Highway improvement project requires submission to the Interstate Planning Committee for review per existing inter-agency agreements. His communication is procedural in nature, neither endorsing nor opposing the project. He is also listed as Executive Director on the Interstate Planning Committee program sheet documenting the IPC's unanimous endorsement of the application.
complaint_summary: Tufford writes to NIPC confirming that NIPC #74-228 (Lincoln Highway improvements) requires submission to the Interstate Planning Committee for review per current inter-agency agreement procedures.

statement.text:
In accordance with current agreements between NIPC and NIRPC, we have reviewed the following summary of Federal Grant Application:
NIPC #74-228 - Illinois Dept. of Transportation - Funding for improvements to FAP Route #23 Lincoln Highway from Cicero Avenue to Chicago Road.
We concur that this project does require submission to the Interstate Planning Committee for their review as prescribed in Section III, Paragraph D, Items 1 and 2, of current agreement.
